exposure: timing of postoperative enteral nutrition (early ≤15 days vs. late >15 days)
outcome: time to achieve total enteral nutrition
cohort: The study included 63 neonates who underwent surgery for gastric perforation and were divided into early and late enteral nutrition groups.
finding: Early postoperative enteral nutrition (within ≤15 days) reduced the time to total enteral nutrition, length of hospital stay, and fistula retention time, without increasing adverse prognosis rates.
